definitions.gloss: peashooter; pea gun (toy that shoots beans)
definitions.explanation: A simple toy gun, traditionally bamboo, that fires small beans or pellets. Mostly encountered today in the idiom {鳩|はと}が{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}を{食|く}ったよう.

examples.japanese: {豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦{鳩|はと}→鳩：05007_hato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}った→食う：02657_kuu⟧ような⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He looked like a pigeon hit by a peashooter — i.e., stunned and wide-eyed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鳩|はと}→鳩：05007_hato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}った→食う：02657_kuu⟧ような⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つめた→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧。
examples.english: At the sudden news, she stared at me with a stunned, wide-eyed look.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧ (bean) + ⟦{鉄砲|てっぽう}→鉄砲：04540_teppou⟧ (gun), with rendaku turning てっぽう into でっぽう. The literal toy is rarely seen today; the word survives mainly in one famous idiom.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{鳩|はと}→鳩：05007_hato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}った→食う：02657_kuu⟧よう: looking startled and dumbfounded, eyes wide open — the image is of a pigeon hit by a sudden tiny shot and frozen in surprise. This is far and away the most common way the word appears in modern Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水鉄砲|みずでっぽう}: water gun — similar construction with a different ammo
- ⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧: toy gun — modern, generic equivalent
